- Convert single `null` argument to `Optional.empty()` in SpEL varargs expression [#27795](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27795)
- Declare serialVersionUID on DefaultAopProxyFactory [#27784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27784)
- The ReactorClientHttpConnector must apply mapper before tcpConfiguration() [#27749](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27749)
- Add getter for RequestMappingInfo builder config [#27723](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27723)
- Give warning when using capturing patterns with the AntPathMatcher [#27688](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27688)
- Support for customization of 404 response when RouterFunctionWebHandler finds no routes [#25358](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25358)
- ModelAndView.status does not work with RedirectView [#25092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25092)
- ThreadPoolExecutorFactoryBean add ability to prestart threads [#1246](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1246)
- Support empty attributes in TagWriter [#910](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/910)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- AsyncConfigurer implementations are loaded too early [#27808](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27808)
- Possible NPE in Spring MVC LogFormatUtils [#27782](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27782)
- Extending CachingConfigurerSupport results in at least one log message about not being eligible for full post-processing [#27751](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27751)
- WebFlux ServerResponse does not overwrite already present response headers [#27741](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27741)
- Passing single null value in varargs SpEL expression results in NullPointerException [#27719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27719)
- UriUtils::extractFileExtension does not properly handle empty file names [#27639](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27639)
- References of CountingBeforeAdvice target its previous location [#22246](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22246)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Remove references to AsyncConfigurerSupport as AsyncConfigurer should be used instead [#27812](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27812)
- Fix javadoc reference to ThrowsAdvice [#27804](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27804)
- Suggested WebSocket config causes circular bean reference [#27746](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27746)
- Document the difference in generics resolution between `@Autowired` and `beanFactory.getBeanProvider` [#27727](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27727)

- Fix incorrect example of error handling in WebClient Javadoc [#27645](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27645)

- Clarify behaviour of AnnotationBeanNameGenerator with acronyms [#2030](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/2030)
- Fix simple data format in appendix [#1025](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1025)
- Update StoredProcedure.java declareParameter method JavaDoc [#1000](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1000)
- Document `@Bean` definitions via default methods [#767](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/767)
- Improved DataBinder Javadoc for xxx*yyy pattern matching. [#699](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/699)

- Configure CommonsMultipartResolver to support specific HTTP methods [#27161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27161)
- Allow BeanDefinitionBuilder to set an instance supplier with a ResolvableType [#27160](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27160)
- Reason of `@ResponseStatus` on handler method is not resolved by MessageSource [#27156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27156)
- ResourceHandlerRegistry#getHandlerMapping should initialize handler once in outer loop [#27153](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27153)
- Set synthetic flag using BeanDefinitionBuilder [#27141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27141)
- BeanCreationException error message should always include declaring class of constructor (or factory method) [#27139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27139)
- Improve Jetty 10 check in JettyClientHttpResponse [#27136](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27136)
- Jetty10RequestUpgradeStrategy use an old jetty 9 class HandshakeRFC6455 [#27121](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27121)
- ClassNotFoundException using Jetty 10 and its reactive client [#27112](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27112)
- Use StringBuilder.append(char) where possible [#27098](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27098)
- Consider "wss" and "https" for secure flag in Forwarded header checks [#27097](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27097)
- SynchronossPartHttpMessageReader should only create temp directory when needed [#27092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27092)
- Implement equals, hashCode, & toString in BeanMethod and *Metadata types [#27076](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27076)
- Remove logging dependency in BeanUtils [#27070](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27070)
- Exclude sealed interfaces from auto-proxying (for JDK 17 compatibility) [#27027](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27027)
- Blockhound error when running with transaction with a TransactionOperator [#26955](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26955)
- Configure StandardServletMultipartResolver to only support multipart/form-data [#26826](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26826)
- Add a way to set executeExistingDelayedTasksAfterShutdown from ThreadPoolTaskScheduler [#26719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26719)
- Apply dynamic changes in ThreadPoolTaskExecutor before setting local value [#26700](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26700)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- JettyHttpHandlerAdapter is not aware of Server[Request|Response]Wrapper [#27146](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27146)
- {*path} pattern (CaptureTheRestPathElement) includes undocumented leading slash in `@PathVariable` path [#27132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27132)
- NoSuchMethodError when invoke JettyWebSocketSession.getRemoteAddress in jetty 10 [#27120](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27120)
- CronExpression is *still* broken on spring-context-5.3.8 [#27117](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27117)
- SimpleMethodMetadataReadingVisitor.Source.toString() omits separator for method arguments [#27095](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27095)
- DefaultPathSegment allows shared empty parameters map to be mutated [#27064](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27064)
- AOP auto-proxying with proxyTargetClass=true and introduction advice does not work for JDK proxy targets [#27044](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27044)
- ServletRequestDataBinder assumes Standard servlet multipart handling [#26999](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26999)
- DataClassRowMapper should not override Kotlin init properties [#26569](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26569)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add Javadoc `@since` to `BeanDefinitionBuilder.setSynthetic()` [#27155](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27155)
- Fix link to Javadoc API [#27151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27151)
- Added description for HandlerInterceptor [#27122](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27122)
- Fix typo in core-beans.adoc [#27113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27113)
- Fix typo in BeanDefinitionDsl.kt [#27105](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27105)
- Improve docs for getContentAsByteArray method of ContentCachingRequestWrapper [#27068](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27068)
- Fix explanation on default settings for content negotiation in reference doc [#27067](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27067)
- Document that any `@Valid*` annotation triggers validation in the reference manual [#27050](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27050)
- Improve RequestPartMethodArgumentResolver Javadoc [#27043](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27043)
- Improve RequestResponseBodyMethodProcessor Javadoc [#27042](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27042)
- Clarify that baseName in ResourceBundleMessageSource does not support multiple locations [#27038](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27038)
- Link alternate documentation formats [#27015](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27015)

- spring-context-indexer doesn't support Java records [#26909](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26909)
- Ignore trailing slash in CorsConfiguration origin patterns [#26892](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26892)
- RSocketRequester disposal of underlying RSocketClient [#26886](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26886)
- Add PreFlightRequestWebFilter [#26885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26885)
- Avoid memory leak when PropertyComparator is reused [#26869](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26869)
- Support MySQL safe updates mode in MySQLMaxValueIncrementer [#26858](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26858)
- HttpStatus.resolve allocates HttpStatus.values() once per invocation [#26842](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26842)
- InvalidPathException in log when running SpringBootTest with NIO Path property on Windows [#26828](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26828)
- Use String.startsWith() instead of String.substring() in PatternMatchUtils [#26822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26822)
- Access to the cachedSessions in CachingConnectionFactory [#26811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26811)
- Reduce log level in ExecutorConfigurationSupport.initialize [#26810](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26810)
- Avoid exceptions when evaluating validation hints [#26787](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26787)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- UriComponentsBuilder handles invalid port numbers correctly [#26905](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26905)
- Incorrect check in AbstractBrokerRegistration's constructor [#26896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26896)
- DataClassRowMapper doesn't correctly convert generic fields [#26881](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26881)
- `CorsRegistration#combine` is a noop [#26877](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26877)
- LinkedCaseInsensitiveMap#putIfAbsent does not honor the case where the key is associated with a null value [#26868](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26868)
- Provide control over fallback charset to use in WebClientResponseException [#26866](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26866)
- `@ModelAttribute(binding=false)` is not honored with WebFlux [#26856](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26856)
- Fix Kotlin filter parameter bug in Router DSLs [#26838](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26838)
- AbstractListenerReadPublisher publishing onComplete signal before onNext during heavy load [#26834](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26834)
- MockMvc's MVC_RESULT_ATTRIBUTE lost with HandlerMappingIntrospector and RouterFunctions in use [#26833](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26833)

- Daylight saving time issue in CronExpression [#26830](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26830)
- HandlerMappingIntrospector does not work with PathPattern backed HandlerMappings [#26814](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26814)
- Addition of fallback patterns to DateFormatter loses cause in Spring 5.3.5 [#26804](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26804)
- Support empty file uploads with HtmlUnit and MockMvc [#26799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26799)
- Cache setup failure does not provide nested cause [#25250](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25250)
- Fix web parameters resolution when injected via constructor [#25200](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25200)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document feature to load `@ModelAttribute`  through type conversion from a request value [#26873](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26873)
- Improve advice on response handling in an ExchangeFilterFunction [#26819](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26819)
- Remove leftover Javadoc from WebClient [#26807](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26807)
- Add information about changed behaviour for resolving `@AuthenticationPrincipal` annotation [#26791](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26791)

- Subscriber context not propagated to WebSocketHandler for Tomcat websockets [#26210](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26210)
- Introduce ApplicationEvents abstraction to capture application events published during a test [#25616](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25616)
- Spring AOP should not apply UndeclaredThrowableException to checked exceptions from Kotlin methods [#23844](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23844)

- Avoid CGLIB proxies in websocket/messaging configuration [#26227](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26227)
- ContentCachingResponseWrapper should not add “Content-Length” when “Transfer-Encoding” is present [#26182](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26182)
- Allow customization of file extension to media type map for WebFlux static resources [#26170](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26170)
- Register bean definition dependencies when used via configuration class injected fields [#26167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26167)
- Print helpful information in RSocket MetadataExtractor [#26130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26130)
- Add ResponseSpec#toEntityFlux overload that accepts BodyExtractor [#26114](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26114)
- Wildcard is a valid Access-Control-Expose-Headers value [#26113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26113)
- Reduce overhead of char[] creation [#26101](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26101)
- EntityManagerFactory startup failure in deferred mode is only available on first use [#26093](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26093)
- `@DynamicPropertySource` is not supported via `@NestedTestConfiguration` semantics [#26091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26091)
- Introduce and() methods in MethodFilter and FieldFilter for composite filters [#26063](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26063)
- Kotlin extensions for WebClient.ResponseSpec [#26030](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26030)
- Validate that JUnit Jupiter test methods and lifecycle methods are not annotated with `@Autowired` [#25966](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25966)
- Add support for SSE to WebMvc.fn [#25920](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25920)
- Template URI Variables with newline %0A or %0D are not matched  [#23252](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23252)

- DataBufferUtils#join may release a DataBuffer more than necessary [#26060](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26060)

- Non-compliant Content-Type header for multipart media types [#25885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25885)

- MergedAnnotationCollectors.toAnnotationSet() should not create intermediate ArrayList [#26031](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26031)

- DefaultWebClientBuilder copies references [#25992](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25992)
- Inefficient request handling inside ServletRequestDataBinder [#25986](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25986)
- Avoid multiple volatile reads/writes in a row where only one is enough [#25899](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25899)
- Allows Jackson2 encoders to log Throwable reason for not being able to serialize or deserialize [#25892](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25892)
- Mechanism to access request bound objects in WebClient filter in servlet env [#25710](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25710)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- SseEmitter: connection closed after first event [#25987](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25987)
- `@Nonnull` annotation breaks ServletRequestMethodArgumentResolver for Principal [#25981](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25981)

- Expose access to STOMP SimpleMessageBroker sessions user Principal [#25191](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25191)
- Allow programmatic registration of completion and error callbacks to transactional event listeners [#24163](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24163)
- Support suspending functions annotated with `@Transactional` [#23575](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23575)
- StompBrokerRelay doesn't send heartbeats to broker when `@MessageMapping` handles received messages [#22822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22822)

- `@NestedTestConfiguration` should not be discovered on enclosing class for nested interface [#25917](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25917)
- UriComponentsBuilder controller method argument has no path [#25822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25822)
- Support multiple matchers in MockMvc Kotlin DSL [#24103](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24103)

- Add MariaDB to the supported database products for procedures and functions [#25811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25811)
- Optimize String argument resolution in MessageTag [#25809](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25809)
- Avoid repeated Charset resolution in MimeType [#25808](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25808)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Incorrect http response for a request using the Range header for pre-compressed resources [#25976](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25976)
- `@ActiveProfiles` with same profiles but different order results in duplicate ApplicationContext [#25973](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25973)
- LinkedMultiValueMap downstream issue with MultiValueMapAdapter package private base class [#25960](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25960)
- DataBufferUtils.CompositeMatcher causes poor performance when one or more matchers does not match [#25915](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25915)
- HttpSeverOperations overrides content-length to 0 on HTTP HEAD [#25908](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25908)
- jsessionid breaks request mappings when removeSemicolonContent is turned off [#25864](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25864)
- JettyClientHttpConnector triggers early cancellation [#25849](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25849)
- Race condition in DataBufferUtils.readAsynchronousFileChannel resulting in FD leak (Channel remains open) [#25831](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25831)
- SimpMessagingTemplate.convertAndSend results in UnsupportedOperationException when Spring Cloud Sleuth is present [#25821](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25821)
- ClassCastException when wiring bean using method injection (NullBean instead of 'null') [#25806](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25806)
- Thread-scoped bean creation freezes if dependent bean is retrieved before dependency bean  [#25801](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25801)
- Sending an event as part of the EMF lock triggers a deadlock [#25799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25799)
- Wrong type inference in Kotlin while overriding RequestMappingHandlerMapping#getMappingForMethod [#25657](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25657)
- SseEmitter (ResponseBodyEmitter) keeps collecting messages if not initialized [#25442](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25442)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Correct DispatcherServlet initialization sample webmvc.adoc [#25965](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25965)
- Document that TransactionalEventListener only works with non-reactive transactions [#25805](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25805)
- Published reference documentation contains unnecessary folders and files [#25783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25783)
- Incorrect example in javadocs of Assert.notNull(object, messageSupplier) [#25774](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25774)

- MultipartFile[] required controller param, not throwing exception [#25819](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25819)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Prevent confusion about build(boolean) method in UriComponentsBuilder [#25701](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25701)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Reactor Californium-SR21 [#25731](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25731)

- Introduce getBeanProvider variants with allowEagerInit flag [#25559](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25559)
- Allow to access the underlying ConnectionFactory from DatabaseClient [#25521](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25521)
- Optimize DefaultLifecycleProcessor::startBeans [#25506](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25506)
- Refactoring opportunity in HandlerExecutionChain [#25500](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25500)
- Support macros in crontab expressions [#25471](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25471)
- Introduce CronExpression [#25464](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25464)
- Use System.currentTimeMillis() in AbstractSockJsService [#25447](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25447)
- Simplified return statement [#25415](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25415)
- Improve UriComponents.sanitizeSource() [#25401](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25401)
- Use Math.min() in ExponentialBackOff [#25381](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25381)
- Allow auto grow for entries without default constructor in SpEL [#25367](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25367)
- Remove redundant Character.toLowerCase() in BeanPropertyRowMapper [#25361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25361)
- Leverage spring.ignore.xml flag to avoid XmlBeanDefinitionReader [#25338](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25338)
- Leverage spring.ignore.xml flag to avoid SQLErrorCodeSQLExceptionTranslator [#25335](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25335)
- Check for valid IPv6 host in UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString [#25334](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25334)
- Support use of RSocketClient [#25332](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25332)
- Enhance HandlerMappingIntrospector to cache parsed patterns [#25312](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25312)
- DefaultSubscriptionRegistry: Reduced thread contention [#25298](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25298)
- Support multiple Content-Language header values in MockHttpServletResponse [#25281](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25281)
- added possibility to extend ModelAttributeMethodArgumentResolver  [#25265](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25265)
- WebSocketMessage's methods `fromMessage` and `toFrames` ignore  Netty WebSocketFrame metadata  [#25099](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25099)
- Support for pattern based origin cors configuration [#25016](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25016)
- Collect metrics during application context startup [#24878](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24878)
- Sort detected PersistenceExceptionTranslator beans [#24644](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24644)
- Constructor based bean binding should support url path variables, not only request parameters [#24107](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24107)
- Feature request: provide support for JSR 310 types in CronTrigger [#23496](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23496)
- RouterFunction does not respect path matching set in WebFluxConfigurer [#23236](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23236)
- Turn MethodArgumentNotValidException into subclass of BindException [#23107](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23107)
- Support for direct path lookups in WebFlux [#22961](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22961)
- ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver should support exceptions from any handler [#22619](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22619)
- `@Scheduled`(cron = "0 0 0 ? * 5#3") is not supported [#22436](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22436)
- Consider updating the default Hibernate dialect for MySQL databases [#22326](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22326)
- Spring MVC - Kotlin: Cannot bind MultipartFile in constructor [SPR-17640] [#22169](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22169)
- Support JSON streaming formats besides application/stream+json [#21283](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21283)
- Support raising exception with a custom HTTP status code [#20336](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20336)
- Support for the last day in month cron expression [SPR-15547] [#20106](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20106)
- Cron Expression validation [SPR-14933] [#19500](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/19500)
- Cron expression with fixed weekday and fixed date may or may not lead to IllegalStateException (runaway search for next trigger) [SPR-8981] [#13621](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13621)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- MockHttpServletResponse's setCharacterEncoding() does not update contentType property [#25536](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25536)
- Bean overriding for 'taskExecutor' alias is not detected [#25430](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25430)
- Creating ServerRequest from MockHttpServletRequest changed behaviour 5.3.0-M1 [#25353](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25353)
- CaffeineCache does not support LoadingCache consistently [#25173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25173)
- CronSequenceGenerator - Friday 13th issue [SPR-17036] [#21574](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21574)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Use Groovy syntax highlighting in reference manual [#25554](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25554)
- Fix comment syntax in xml examples [#25537](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25537)
- Fix links in Javadoc [#25448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25448)
- Fix typo in javadoc [#25396](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25396)
- Add logging reference documentation [SPR-17626] [#22158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22158)

- Upgrade to Jackson 2.11.2 [#25398](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25398)

- Upgrade to ASM 9.0 [#24872](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24872)
- Upgrade to Kotlin 1.4 RC [#24171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24171)

- MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter might be too specific in its Charset support [#25322](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25322)

- Implement reliable invocation order for advice within an `@Aspect` [#25186](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25186)
- Performance enhancement in execution of ResponseEntity.of() [#25183](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25183)
- Support for shared GroovyClassLoader in GroovyScriptFactory [#25177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25177)
- Suggest making a Set.size() > 0 judgement for AbstractApplicationContext.earlyApplicationEvents [#25161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25161)
- Make use of custom types configurable in YamlProcessor [#25152](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25152)
- Avoid need for default constructor in ContextAnnotationAutowireCandidateResolver subclasses [#25131](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25131)
-  ConstructorResolver.resolveConstructorArguments() return value issue [#25130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25130)
- Introduce serializeToByteArray/deserializeFromByteArray convenience methods [#25117](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25117)
- Custom HTTP Method on MockServerHttpRequest [#25109](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25109)
- Missing null checks in AbstractMessageChannel.addInterceptor/setInterceptors [#25088](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25088)
- Avoid full synchronization in AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext.getBeanFactory() since it can lead to massive thread blocking [#25081](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25081)
- Simplify use of HttpContext in HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory in support of user associated connections [#25066](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25066)
- ResolvableType forClass fails when a type in the generic signature isn't present [#25064](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25064)
- Include timeout unit in shutdown failure logging [#25058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25058)
- Drop unnecessary intermediate StringBuilder.toString() call in ServerSentEventHttpMessageReader [#25024](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25024)
- Fix concurrency issues in XStreamMarshaller [#25017](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25017)
- Introduce mechanism to discover whether a reactive type registered in ReactiveAdapterRegistry uses deferred computation [#24995](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24995)
- Avoid logging exception for closed session in AbstractSockJsSession [#24986](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24986)
- Include response body in RestTemplate exception when there is no suitable HttpMessageConverter [#24964](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24964)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- ExchangeStrategies custom codec's reader & writer are not registered [#25149](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25149)
- MultiValueMapAdapter.getFirst fails with IndexOutOfBoundsException in case of empty List [#25140](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25140)
- WebSphereUowTransactionManager causes exception for PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS when timeout is specified [#25132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25132)
- Avoid ClassCastException on IllegalArgumentException when invoking sync get cache method [#25110](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25110)
- DefaultServerRequestBuilder does not respect attributes when building the ServerRequest [#25106](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25106)
- Fix race condition in WriteResultPublisher between subscription and error in publishError [#25096](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25096)
- Jackson message converters and codecs do not respect character encoding in canRead/canWrite [#25076](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25076)
- DefaultClientResponseBuilder empty logPrefix when creating a DefaultClientResponse based on another [#25069](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25069)
- HttpHeaders equals may return false without comparing actual content [#25034](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25034)
- Fix race condition in WriteResultPublisher between subscription and completion in publishComplete [#24989](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24989)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Javadoc for hibernate5 OpenSessionInViewFilter mentions FlushMode.NEVER [#25158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25158)
- Document that the Map backing a MapPropertySource should not contain null values [#25142](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25142)
- Javadoc for JdbcOperations.batchUpdate should mention that negative values are possible [#25138](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25138)
- Fix URI pattern example in webflux.adoc [#25137](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25137)
- Document how reactive transactions work for cancellation in 5.2 and how it will work in 5.3 [#25091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25091)
- Document whether code can rely on specific subclasses of HttpClientErrorException/HttpServerErrorException being thrown from DefaultResponseErrorHandler [#25067](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25067)
- Fix SpelEvaluationException with example code [#25045](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25045)
- javadoc: remove a comment documented a limitation on `@Lookup` annotation [#25044](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25044)
- Document all predefined variables from ApplicationContext available in SpEL expressions [#25037](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25037)
- Document ReactiveTransactionManager support in reference manual [#25036](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25036)
- Document ReactiveTransactionManager support [#25030](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25030)
- Change to placeholder value in XML is not reevaluated at runtime [#25022](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25022)
- Add missing `@PathVariable` declarations in examples in webmvc.adoc [#25006](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25006)

- Illegal reflective access warning for interface-based lookup method injection [#24657](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24657)
- Annotation retrieval performance degradation after 5.2 [#23905](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23905)

- Avoid ClassCastException for CoyoteInputStream in TomcatHttpHandlerAdapter [#24707](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24707)
- Avoid unnecessary sorting in AbstractHandlerMethodMapping [#24704](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24704)

- Relax GraalVM checks in DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer [#24600](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24600)
- Multipart/related support in Spring Webclient [#24582](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24582)
- Consider supporting PreFlight requests and CORS in Servlet Functional Endpoints [#24564](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24564)
- Support for byte-range requests in Servlet Functional endpoints [#24562](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24562)
- Provide a mechanism to configure integration tests with a dynamic property source [#24540](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24540)
- Improve ConcurrentLruCache performance [#24469](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24469)

- implements `checkNotModified` for `ServerRequest` [#24173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24173)

- addCandidateComponentsFromIndex should create ScannedGenericBeanDefinitions [#24638](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24638)

- Polish ReactorResourceFactory [#24620](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24620)

- NullPointerException in MockHttpServletRequestBuilder for URI string with no protocol [#24556](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24556)
- BeanPostProcessorChecker warning due to missing infrastructure role on ProxyTransactionManagementConfiguration [#24508](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24508)
- spring-aspects has a compile dependency on spring-orm [#24491](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24491)
- AbstractJackson2Decoder is not aware of jackson's non-blocking parser only supporting UTF-8 [#24489](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24489)
- MockRestServiceServer reset does not clear failedRequests [#24486](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24486)
- Prevent unnecessary refresh for InjectionMetadata.EMPTY [#24485](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24485)
- "Status and headers already sent" ISE exception from Reactor Netty on WebSocket upgrade [#24475](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24475)
- The new Encoder.encodeValue and Decoder.decode methods in spring 5.2 do not provide access to the Context [#24441](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24441)
- Cycle in LogAdapter.Log4jLog initialization within log appender [#24440](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24440)
- Negative byte values not properly converted to unsigned int in URI encoding [#24413](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24413)
- ServerSentEventHttpMessageReader maps null when event has comment only. [#24389](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24389)
- Nested annotations no longer supported in ASM-based annotation processing [#24375](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24375)
- Explicit Content-Type Header in WebClient is overwritten by ResourceHttpMessageWriter [#24366](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24366)
- Avoid setting special Content-* response headers in TomcatHeadersAdapter [#24361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24361)
- IncompatibleClassChangeError encountered on execution of compiled SPEL expressions [#24357](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24357)
- JSON decoding error parsing stream encoded with Jackson Smile [#24198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24198)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Improve documentation for `@Autowired`/`@Value` in `@Configuration` classes [#24585](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24585)
- Fix formatting in webflux-webclient.adoc [#24578](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24578)
- Clarify AbstractResourceBasedMessageSource.setCacheMillis vs java.util.ResourceBundle [#24563](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24563)
- Correct Ant-style Patterns example in documentation [#24552](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24552)
- Fix javadoc in DependencyDescriptor [#24551](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24551)
- Correct formatting of MessageSource example in documentation [#24531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24531)
- Update advice on RestTemplate [#24503](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24503)
- Upgrade to Spring Asciidoctor Extensions 0.4.0.RELEASE [#24481](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24481)
- Fix typo in StringUtils class [#24471](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24471)
- Polish documentation format [#24460](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24460)
- Fix Asciidoctor Warnings [#24427](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24427)
- Reconsider recommended connection pools [#24405](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24405)
- Improve default experience of data binding from HTML date and time input fields [#24370](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24370)
- Document supported characters for identifiers in SpEL expressions [#24359](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24359)
- Document that `@Validated` results in the use of a proxy and warn users about the side-effects [#24338](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24338)
- Deprecate use of path extensions in request mapping and content negotiation [#24179](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24179)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Reactor Dysprosium SR5 [#24355](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24355)
- Upgrade to JUnit Jupiter 5.6 [#24299](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24299)

- ReadCancellationException does not play well with `onErrorContinue` [#24125](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24125)

- Optimize `ClassUtils#getMostSpecificMethod` [#31100](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31100)
- Optimize whitespace checks in `StringUtils` [#31069](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31069)
- Align validation metadata handling in `PayloadMethodArgumentResolver` [#31056](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31056)
- Register an override for an existing adapter in `ReactiveAdapterRegistry` [#31048](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31048)
- Make bean initialization deterministic for multiple `@Autowired` methods on same bean class [#30994](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30994)
- Performance bottlenecks while creating scoped bean instances [#30892](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30892)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Possible classloader leak through incomplete clearing of annotation caches [#31176](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31176)
- Spring `LogFactory` implementation deviates from original Apache `LogFactory` in terms of abstract method declarations [#31167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31167)
- Bean injection fails due to `nullSafeConciseToString()` invoking `isEmpty()` on a `Map`/`Collection` proxy [#31156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31156)
- SpelExpressionParser throws IllegalStateException instead of ParseException for invalid expression [#31099](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31099)
- `@DynamicPropertySource` in `@Nested` test class cannot override dynamic properties from enclosing class [#31085](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31085)
- `TransactionalApplicationListenerMethodAdapter` should find `@TransactionalEventListener` on target class method [#31037](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31037)
- ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor: graceful shutdown should not interrupt currently running jobs [#31020](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31020)
- Permgen memory leak due to `ClassInfo` caching in `java.beans.Introspector` on JDK 11/17 [#31005](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31005)
- `MethodIntrospector.selectMethods(?)` fails to find methods in case of special bridge method arrangement [#30907](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30907)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix documentation: Passing in Lists of Values for IN Clause does not work with JdbcTemplate [#31229](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31229)
- Refine CORS documentation for wildcard processing [#31168](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31168)
- Propagation REQUIRES_NEW may cause connection pool deadlock [#31040](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31040)
- Clarify R2DBC `ConnectionAccessor` and `DatabasePopulator` exception declarations [#30933](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30933)
- Doc: Avoid deadlock in `@PostConstruct` through SmartInitializingSingleton or ContextRefreshedEvent github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/tarball/v6.1.0-M4","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.1.0-M4","body":"## :star: New Features

- Support resource patterns in `@TestPropertySource` locations [#31055](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31055)
- Support text blocks for inlined properties in `@TestPropertySource` [#31053](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31053)
- `@Bean` method should be always allowed to override scanned class matching its return type [#31052](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31052)
- Support finding repeatable annotations in `AnnotatedTypeMetadata` [#31041](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31041)
- Fail fast if a `@Bean` method has a void return type [#31007](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31007)
- Use `Class#arrayType()` where feasible [#31002](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31002)
- `ReactiveAdapterRegistry` is not compatible with Mutiny 2 [#31000](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31000)
- Avoid thread pinning in SseEmitter write operations [#30996](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30996)
- Add support for property file encoding in `@TestPropertySource` [#30982](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30982)
- Support custom properties file formats in `@TestPropertySource` [#30981](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30981)
- Support `@HttpExchange` for server side handling  [#30980](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30980)
- Fail on error by default during test AOT processing [#30977](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30977)
- Deprecate `applyBeanPostProcessorsBeforeInitialization` and `applyBeanPostProcessorsAfterInitialization` in the `AutowireCapableBeanFactory` interface [#30974](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30974)
- Provide methods for obtaining include/exclude path patterns in `MappedInterceptor` [#30971](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30971)
- Introduce `SimpleAsyncTaskScheduler` with virtual threads support (as an alternative to `ThreadPoolTaskScheduler`)  [#30956](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30956)
- Support declarative mode for data binding [#30948](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30948)
- Support customizing the bind parameter name for constructor binding [#30947](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30947)
- Support `@RSocketExchange` for responding [#30936](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30936)
- Introduce `JdbcClient` with unified parameter capabilities (as a JDBC variant of `DatabaseClient`) [#30931](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30931)
- Allow preferred constructor to be defined at the `BeanDefinition` level [#30917](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30917)
- Remove obsolete native image reflection hint registration for `TransactionDefinition` constants [#30854](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30854)
- Deprecate `Constants` utility and stop using it internally [#30851](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30851)
- Use `Long.parseLong(CharSequence,int,int,int)` to avoid intermediate `String` creation [#30710](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30710)
- Support Kotlin value class properties in SpEL [#30468](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30468)
- Add observability support for JMS [#30335](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30335)
- `@TransactionalEventListener` does not work with `SimpleApplicationEventMulticaster.setTaskExecutor` [#30244](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30244)
- Direct autowiring of existing collection subtype bean if `ApplicationContext` contains beans of type `T` [#30022](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30022)
- Clarify `FactoryBean.OBJECT\_TYPE\_ATTRIBUTE` supported types [#29799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29799)
- Add support for Kotlin inline/value classes in `BeanUtils` [#28638](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28638)
- Publish event for `@TransactionalEventListener` with Spring WebFlux [#27515](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27515)
- Introduce `TransactionExecutionListener` callback API [#27479](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27479)
- R2DBC - DatabaseClient - Add bind method to accept an object [#27282](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27282)
- Introduce RowMapper with automatic binding to fields [#26594](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26594)
- Add support for Class-based mapping in DatabaseClient [#26021](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26021)
- `@Component` not picked up by `@ComponentScan` if it has the same simple name as the main class [#25952](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25952)
- Support custom TimeUnits in StopWatch [#25803](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25803)
- `@Lookup` doesn't work in case of AbstractBeanFactory's cacheBeanMetadata=false [#25749](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25749)
- Injection of List<Resource> is inconsistent with Resource[] [#24845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24845)
- Provide guidance and better diagnostics when dependency injection makes a bean ineligible for complete post-processing [#24092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24092)
- Availability of a bean definition's resolved factory method depends upon a side-effect of getBeanNamesForType which is lost when metadata caching is disabled [#23795](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23795)
- Validate `afterThrowing` method signature in `ThrowsAdviceInterceptor` [#1896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1896)
- Support resource patterns in `@PropertySource` locations [SPR-16785] [#21325](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21325)
- Increase reusability of `Validator` [SPR-15314] [#19877](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/19877)
- Support additional file formats in `ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource` [#18990](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18990)
- Reactive types support for `@Cacheable` methods [SPR-14235] [#17920](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17920)
- Support caching annotations for `CompletableFuture` return values [SPR-12967] [#17559](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17559)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Move `ServerWebExchange` Kotlin extensions to the right package [#31046](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31046)
- Spring does not find all `@ComponentScan` or `@PropertySource` annotations [#30941](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30941)
- 404 on static resource does not return ProblemDetail response  [#30930](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30930)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document `@AliasFor` support in `AnnotatedTypeMetadata.getAnnotationAttributes()` [#31042](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31042)
- Update documentation for HTTP Interface return values [#30959](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30959)
- Update documentation for data binding improvements [#30952](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30952)
- Use of `ApplicationEventPublisher` in a reactive call stack [SPR-16481] [#21025](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21025)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to JUnit 5.10 [#30970](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30970)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.12.0-M2 [#30997](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30997)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2023.0.0-M2  [#31014](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31014)

## :heart: Contributors

Thank you to all the contributors who worked on this release:

- Update warning log messages for SimpleAsyncTaskManager to take into account virtual thread mode [#30902](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30902)
- Extract forwarded header handling out of UriComponentsBuilder [#30886](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30886)

- Revisit public API for `MBeanExporter` [#30874](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30874)
- Early support for JDK 22 [#30845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30845)
- DataAccessUtils result accessors with Optional return value [#27735](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27735)
- Add convert(Object, TypeDescriptor) method to ConversionService [#25394](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25394)
- Revisit DataAccessException translation API [#24634](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24634)

- `@CachePut` evaluates key before cache condition [#22769](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22769)

- Update javadoc to take virtual threads into account [#30905](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30905)

ork/tarball/v6.1.0-M2","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.1.0-M2","body":"## :star: New Features

- Refine the log message printed after restoration with CRaC [#30876](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30876)
- Add HttpExchangeAdapter for RestClient [#30869](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30869)
- Use latest version of `sockjs-client` in `AbstractSockJsService` [#30848](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30848)
- ClientHttpRequestFactory based on Reactor Netty HttpClient [#30835](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30835)
- Pause/resume capability for `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor` and `ThreadPoolTaskScheduler` [#30831](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30831)
- Rearrange HttpHeader adapters [#30823](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30823)
- Support use of MockRestServiceServer with RestClient [#30821](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30821)
- Allow built ServerResponse to throw exception [#30818](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30818)
- Method validation error handling by controller method parameter type [#30813](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30813)
- Add `RestClient` Kotlin extensions [#30807](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30807)
- Detect interface parameter annotations also from spring-messaging HandlerMethod [#30801](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30801)
- Allows JdkClientHttpRequest.DISALLOWED\_HEADERS to be customized. [#30788](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30788)
- Change restore logging to info level [#30775](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30775)
- Add MultipartFileArgumentResolver for HTTP interface client [#30728](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30728)
- Align KeyValues of Scheduled-annotated observability with OpenTelemetry conventions [#30721](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30721)
- Detect invalid transaction configuration for transactional event listeners [#30679](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30679)
- Blocking execution for WebFlux controller methods [#30678](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30678)
- Add a CoExchangeFilterFunction for WebClient similar to CoWebFilter [#30650](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30650)
- Built-in Web Support for Method Bean Validation [#30645](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30645)
- Spring MVC and WebFlux handling of method validation errors [#30644](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30644)
- HttpClient based ClientHttpRequestFactory [#30478](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30478)
- HTTP interface client infrastructure and adapter for RestTemplate [#30117](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30117)
- Instrument Scheduled-annotated methods for observability [#29883](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29883)
- Add AOT support for Kotlin constructors with optional parameters [#29820](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29820)
- Introduce RestClient [#29552](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29552)
- Space in integer request parameter neither triggers the default value nor generates a 400 [#29550](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29550)
- Improve 404 error handling in Spring MVC [#29491](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29491)
- Issue with `equals(?)`/`hashCode()` for `ResolvableType.forRawClass(?)` [#28608](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28608)
- Introduce `ModuleResource` for resources loaded from a given `Module` [#28507](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28507)
- `ArrayToCollectionConverter` should default to `List` if target type is `Collection` [#28048](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28048)
- ResolvableType should allow to determine matching type argument for generic return type [#27748](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27748)
- Parallel graceful shutdown for `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor` and `ThreadPoolTaskScheduler` [#27090](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27090)
- Support target instantiation and binding via constructor in DataBinder [#26721](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26721)
- Support for MultiValueMap elements in web data binding [#26297](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26297)
- Add binding support to functional servlet and reactive stack [#25943](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25943)
- `@Scheduled` methods in beans created by FactoryBeans are not cancelled [#24629](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24629)
- `ExecutorConfigurationSupport` API refinement to control internal executor shutdown [#24497](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24497)
- DataBinder using constructor parameter should use path variables [#22748](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22748)
- Add JDBC SqlValue classes for arrays [#1850](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1850)
- Support Kotlin parameter default values in HTTP handler methods [#21139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21139)
- Multiple TaskSchedulers to be supported with `@Scheduled` [SPR-16271] [#20818](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20818)
- Let the DataBinder construct nested objects [#20806](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20806)

k/tarball/v6.0.11","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.0.11","body":"## :star: New Features

- Reduce `WARN` level log output during test AOT processing [#30867](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30867)
- Avoid need for reflection hints for `MBeanExporter` in native image [#30846](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30846)
- Tolerate `AnnotationUtils.isCandidateClass` call with `null` as annotation type [#30842](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30842)
- Simplify `DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry.isDependent()` [#30839](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30839)
- Add missing `@Nullable` annotations in ContentDisposition.Builder [#30820](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30820)
- Provide explicit support for collections, maps, and arrays in `ObjectUtils.nullSafeConciseToString()` [#30810](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30810)
- Extend list of supported types in `ObjectUtils.nullSafeConciseToString()` [#30805](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30805)
- Align ConcurrentMapCacheManager locking behavior with CaffeineCacheManager [#30780](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30780)
- Improve logging for missing dependencies in `MicrometerObservationRegistryTestExecutionListener` [#30747](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30747)
- Optimize `KotlinReflectionParameterNameDiscoverer` [#30725](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30725)
- Change `InvocableHandlerMethod#invokeSuspendingFunction` return type to `Object` [#30716](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30716)
- `ResolvableType.hasUnresolvableGenerics()` should cache its result [#30713](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30713)
- Deprecate RootBeanDefinition(ResolvableType) constructor [#30704](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30704)
- Reinstate dependency injection support for legacy JSR-250 `@javax.annotation.Resource` annotation [#30695](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30695)
- Translate SQL Exception with State S0001 and Vendor Code 2628 to a Spring Exception in MSSQL 2019 [#30681](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30681)
- Ensure Spring `LogFactory` contains all public methods from Apache `LogFactory` [#30668](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30668)
- Infer hints required for aspects [#28711](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28711)
- Improve diagnostics for CGLIB ClassLoader issues with shared classes in parent ClassLoader [#25940](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25940)
- `JdbcTemplate` does not call `handleWarnings` in case of exception [#23106](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23106)
- Avoid illegal reflective access in ContextOverridingClassLoader.isEligibleForOverriding [#22791](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22791)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Revert changes to `toString()` in `FieldError` [#30799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30799)
- For a prototype bean, if first-time rejected value is null, subsequent value will wrongly be null always [#30794](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30794)
- Fix log level on error with `@TransactionalEventListener` [#30776](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30776)
- ClassCastException in `AbstractBeanDefinition.getBeanClassName()` when getting bean multithreaded [#30773](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30773)
- SerializableTypeWrapper does not consistently catch InvocationTargetException  [#30764](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30764)
- NPE in MvcUriComponentsBuilder with no-arg target method on interface [#30756](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30756)
- ArithmeticException: long overflow on `@Scheduled`(fixedDelay = Long.MAX\_VALUE) [#30754](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30754)
- `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder` breaks when `modules` customizer follows `modulesToInstall` [#30751](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30751)
- `NullPointerException` in reactive `TransactionalOperatorImpl` [#30729](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30729)
- `MicrometerObservationRegistryTestExecutionListener` uses wrong `ClassLoader` to detect dependencies [#30726](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30726)
- Support [package-]private init/destroy methods in AOT mode [#30724](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30724)
- Package-private init/destroy methods are not always invoked [#30718](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30718)
- Generic RedisKeyExpiredEvent not delivered to `@EventListener` anymore in 6.0.9 [#30712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30712)
- Explicit BeanDefinition#targetType is not honoured in AOT scenarios [#30689](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30689)
- Spring ORM SpringBeanContainer when trying to create a bean fails with not found bean definition, and fallbacks to default hibernate bean creation [#30683](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30683)
- PathResourceResolver#resolve\*Internal is missing `@Nullable` declarations [#30601](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30601)
- Code generation should only apply shortcut if the target method is not ambiguous [#29278](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29278)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Update STOMP documentation with the new guidelines [#30857](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30857)
- Clarify `ReactiveTransactionManager` exception declarations [#30817](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30817)
- Doc: `JdbcTransactionManager` vs `DataSourceTransactionManager` [#30802](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30802)
- Fix typo in Javadoc for `BeanDefinitionDsl.kt` [#30798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30798)
- Remove `@Aspect` for classes containing only `@Pointcut` declarations in reference documentation [#30790](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30790)
- NestedRuntimeException javadoc not updated after implementation change [#30748](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30748)
- `AbstractMessageListenerContainer` documentation and code disagree regarding log level [#30730](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30730)
- Fix link text from "null" to "Component Classes" in Testing chapter [#30714](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30714)
- Document that `RowCallbackHandler` can be used with `NamedParameterJdbcTemplate` [#30705](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30705)
- Javadoc HTML tables are no longer rendered properly since upgrade to Java 17 [#30701](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30701)
- Fix typo in `UriUtils` Javadoc [#30598](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30598)
- Fix example in Javadoc for `MultipartBodyBuilder` [#30593](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30593)
- Elaborate on ShallowEtagHeaderFilter limitations [#30517](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30517)
- Document how to configure a custom LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean to work with native [#30498](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30498)
- Document that `@Sql` requires `spring-jdbc` and `spring-tx` on the classpath [#30280](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30280)
- Document limitations of Servlet Filter observations [#29398](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29398)
- Warn against direct usage of Servlet API in WebFlux applications [#28872](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28872)
- ResultSet holdability into the View layer broken by Hibernate 5 [#26557](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26557)

:star: New Features

- Consistent simple value type check (including UUID treatment for data binding) [#30664](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30664)
- Release shared JMS Connection when message listener container is stopped [#30612](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30612)
- Property-driven onRefresh checkpoint during application context bootstrap [#30606](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30606)
- Support letters other than A-Z in identifiers in SpEL expressions [#30580](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30580)
- Remove System.out calls in PreComputeFieldFeature [#30571](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30571)
- Have the ErrorResponse.Builder take in a custom ProblemDetail instance  [#30568](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30568)
- Allow setting the ProblemDetail.type via a MessageSource [#30566](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30566)
- ClientHttpRequestFactory based on Jetty HttpClient [#30564](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30564)
- Remove buffering in ClientHttpRequestFactory implementations [#30557](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30557)
- Support JAXBElement in Jaxb2XmlEncoder [#30552](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30552)
- Disable SpEL selector support in WebSocket messaging by default [#30550](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30550)
- Enforce JPA bootstrap failure for incomplete Hibernate Validator setup [#30549](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30549)
- Support parsing `long` dates in `InstantFormatter` [#30546](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30546)
- Port BeanPropertyRowMapper and DataClassRowMapper for r2dbc [#30530](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30530)
- Add non-null precondition checks in `DefaultEntityResponseBuilder` [#30433](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30433)
- Deprecate spring-context-indexer [#30431](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30431)
- Update `RuntimeHintsAgentPlugin` to use the native image code path [#30422](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30422)
- HTTP interface client should not have blockingTimeout set and leave it to the underlying client by default [#30403](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30403)
- Improve `toString()` for `Profiles.of()` implementation [#30374](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30374)
- Add ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource Resource selection hook [#30369](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30369)
- Optimize DefaultLifecycleProcessor::stopBeans [#30361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30361)
- Deprecate `AutowireCapableBeanFactory.createBean(Class, int, boolean)` for consistent usage of `createBean(Class)` [#30345](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30345)
- Support `setCharacterEncoding(null)` in `MockHttpServletResponse` [#30341](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30341)
- Add support for converting a String to an Instant [#30312](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30312)
- Refine `RouterFunctionMapping` ordering consistency [#30278](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30278)
- CRaC Resource adapter for bean lifecycle in application context [#30242](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30242)
- Configuration options for virtual threads [#30241](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30241)
- Support for SequencedCollection/Set/Map [#30239](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30239)
- MethodArgumentNotValidException::errorsToStringList should include only the resolved message when MessageSource is used [#30198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30198)
- Support `@XmlSeeAlso` in Jaxb2XmlDecoder [#30167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30167)
- Add SpEL support for registered MethodHandles [#30045](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30045)
- Add test support to record async events, with JUnit Jupiter caveat [#30020](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30020)
- Returning a `CompletableFuture.failure()` from an async, transactional method should mark the transaction as roll back [#30018](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30018)
- Support `@Scheduled` on Reactive methods and Kotlin suspending functions [#29924](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29924)
- Compatibility with JVM checkpoint restore (OpenJDK's Project CRaC) [#29921](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29921)
- `Validator` factory methods with `BiConsumer` [#29890](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29890)
- Spring MVC and WebFlux method validation support that also adapts `ConstraintViolation`s [#29825](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29825)
- Remove LocalVariableTableParameterNameDiscoverer [#29559](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29559)
- Avoid use of `java.net.URL` constructors [#29481](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29481)
- Creating relative resource for URL resource should create relative Resource even if relative path has URL in it [#28522](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28522)
- ModelAttributeMethodArgumentResolver does not support custom field binding for immutable objects [#28284](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28284)
- ConcurrentTaskScheduler and ConcurrentTaskExecutor can create an executor with no way to shut it down [#27914](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27914)
- R2DBC ConnectionFactory bean `.close()` method should be called/subscribed when available [#26991](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26991)
- org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.ReactiveTypeHandler does not handle vendor-specific application/x-ndjson media types [#26817](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26817)
- Improve the experience of handling validation errors in controller methods [#26219](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26219)
- Compatibility with virtual threads (OpenJDK's Project Loom) [#23443](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23443)
- Avoid repeated attempts to load a failing `ApplicationContext` in the TestContext framework [SPR-9548] [#14182](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14182)

:star: New Features

- Add missing hint for `ResourceEditor` [#30628](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30628)
- Add missing hint for converting String to URI [#30627](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30627)
- Redesign inner Pointcut implementations as standalone classes [#30621](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30621)
- Add missing `@Nullable` in DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory [#30620](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30620)
- Handle custom JMS acknowledgment modes as client acknowledge [#30619](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30619)
- Declare Advisor#isPerInstance() as default method [#30614](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30614)
- Improve error message for unsupported character in SpEL expression [#30602](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30602)

- Always use `MethodArgumentNotValidException(MethodParameter, BindingResult)` constructor [#30558](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30558)

- Add missing `EntityManagerFactory` hints for `SharedEntityManagerCreator` [#30523](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30523)
- Disable Hibernate reflection optimizer with native [#30521](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30521)
- Introduce a method in `MockHttpServletRequestBuilder` to set remote address [#30497](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30497)
