- Align HibernateJpaVendorAdapter with Hibernate ORM 6.2 [#30288](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30288)
- Add nested propagation support to R2dbcTransactionManager  [#30134](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30134)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Cron expression scheduling might be triggered 1 millisecond earlier [#30666](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30666)
- Change of behaviour for UUID in bean validation output in v5.3.27 [#30661](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30661)
- Test context cache stats are not logged when `ApplicationContext` fails to load [#30635](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30635)
- Inconsistent ProxyCallbackFilter#equals/hashCode methods in CglibAopProxy [#30615](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30615)
- SpEL's `CompoundExpression.toStringAST()` incorrectly includes `.` for indexed properties [#30610](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30610)
- NPE in `ReactiveTransactionSupport.unwrapIfResourceCleanupFailure` [#30597](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30597)
- CollectionFactory.createMap(HashMap.class, 0) now returns a LinkedHashMap rather than a HashMap [#30596](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30596)
- ThreadLocalTargetSource does not include actual target bean name in NamedThreadLocal [#30581](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30581)
- ApplicationListenerMethodAdapter inconsistently publishes events from CompletableFuture [#30578](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30578)
- Unsupported SQL type: TIMESTAMP\_WITH\_TIMEZONE when using OffsetDateTime with MySQL [#30556](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30556)

- WebFlux returns 406 instead of RFC 7807 response for subtype of ProblemDetail [#30533](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30533)
- HTTP Interface client cannot send URI query parameter with multipart request [#30520](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30520)
- Transaction isolation level not working with R2dbcTransactionManager  [#30508](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30508)
- Support for AOT processing with GraalVM tracing agent is not consistent [#30511](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30511)
- For `@Bean` method that returns `null`, `@Autowired` injects `NullBean` instead of `null` for cached arguments [#30485](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30485)
- MediaType property binding issue in native builds [#30491](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30491)
- InjectionMetadata AOT contributions do not check for existing property value [#30476](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30476)
- Spring Framework 6.0.8 appears to cause issues in OSGi environment [#30389](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30389)
- Empty `@RequestMapping` method should match both "" and "/" consistently [#30293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30293)
- EclipseLinkJpaDialect: Unexpected default isolation levels [#29997](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29997)

- Improve diagnostics in SpEL for repeated text [#30143](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30143)
- Increase scope of regex pattern cache for the SpEL `matches` operator [#30141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30141)
- Minor updates in HandlerMappingIntrospector [#30128](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30128)
- Allow SnakeYaml 2.0 runtime compatibility [#30097](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30097)
- Add missing `@Nullable` annotations to `LogMessage.format` methods [#30009](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30009)
- ASM upgrade for JDK 20/21 support [#29966](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29966)
- Allow MockRest to match header/queryParam value list with one Matcher [#29964](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29964)
- Add `MockMvc.multipart()` Kotlin extensions with `HttpMethod` [#29941](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29941)
- Release R2DBC connection when cleanup fails in transaction [#29925](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29925)
- org.springframework.web.context.ContextLoader should lazily load ContextLoader.properties [#29909](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29909)
- Improve generated default name for `@JmsListener` subscription [#29902](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29902)
- Include all Hibernate query methods in `SharedEntityManagerCreator`'s `queryTerminatingMethods` set [#29888](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29888)
- SQL supplier in R2DBC `DatabaseClient` is eagerly invoked [#29887](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29887)
- Spring Framework 5.3.x is incompatible with Jetty 10 (Client) [#29867](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29867)
- Possible infinite forward loop with MockMvcWebConnection [#29866](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29866)
- Refine `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder#configureFeature` exception handling [#29860](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29860)
- Fix R2dbcTransactionManager debug log: don't log a Mono [#29824](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29824)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- RequestedContentTypeResolver does not ignore quality factor when filtering \*/\* media types [#30121](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30121)
- SpEL: cannot call methods declared in `java.lang.Object` on a JDK proxy [#30118](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30118)
- CaffeineCacheManager getCache method cause thread block [#30085](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30085)
- Protect JMS connection creation against prepareConnection errors [#30051](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30051)
- ReactorServerHttpRequest does not reflect forwarded host and port when `forwarding-header-strategy=native` or cloud platform detected [#29974](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29974)
- WebSocket stats not updated correctly when sessions cleared [#29947](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29947)
- Explicit target ClassLoader for interface-based proxies in MvcUriComponentsBuilder [#29914](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29914)
- Closing an ApplicationContext leads to Exception at ExecutorServiceAdapter [#29908](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29908)
- Invalid Accept header results in IllegalStateException [#29836](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29836)
- JettyWebSocketCreator referenced from a method is not visible from class loader with `Jetty10RequestUpgradeStrategy` [#29256](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29256)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix minor spacings in webflux docs [#30095](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30095)
- `@AspectJ` argument name resolution algorithm is outdated in reference manual [#30057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30057)
- Fix "Configuring a Global Date and Time Format" example [#30036](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30036)
- Consistent `@Bean` method return type for equivalence with XML example [#29970](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29970)
- Update `@DynamicPropertySource` examples regarding changes in Testcontainers [#29940](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29940)
- Clarify semantics of `primitivesDefaultedForNullValue` in `BeanPropertyRowMapper` [#29926](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29926)
- Clearly document that `DataClassRowMapper` supports Java records [#29922](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29922)
- Outdated Javadoc for AbstractApplicationContext.postProcessBeanFactory [#29916](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29916)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Reactor Netty 2020.0.30 [#30116](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30116)

:star: New Features

- Avoid reflection for annotation method invocations [#29448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29448)
- Avoid unnecessary allocations in StompDecoder#unescape [#29443](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29443)
- Avoid String allocations in MediaType.checkParameters [#29428](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29428)
- Reduce allocations caused by producible media types [#29412](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29412)

- Filter out `null` WebSocket session attributes [#29315](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29315)
-  Introduce TestSocketUtils as a replacement for SocketUtils [#29132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29132)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Missing SessionFactory property (filter AutoCloseable from PropertyDescriptors)  [#29480](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29480)
- SpEL ternary and Elvis expressions are missing enclosing parentheses in toStringAST() [#29463](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29463)
- If-Unmodified-Since header check removes Last-Modified and Etag headers from response, even if condition passes [#29362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29362)
- Annotation searches fail for non-public repeatable annotations [#29301](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29301)
- AbstractBeanFactory's interaction with BeanPostProcessorCacheAwareList is not fully thread-safe [#29299](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29299)
- WebTestClient cannot assert custom HTTP status code [#29283](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29283)
- Body token not expected error when trying to upload a large multipart file [#29227](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29227)
- Avoid resizing of Maps created by CollectionUtils [#29190](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29190)
- DefaultWebClient logging sensitive information in URI [#29148](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29148)
- Fix SimpleMailMessage nullability annotations [#29139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29139)
- Webflux fails to apply the rule for controller methods returning void to kotlin suspend functions returning Unit [#27629](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27629)
- Resource.isFile() return true when the resource path actually not exists [#26707](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26707)
- AnnotatedElementUtils does not find merged repeatable annotations on other repeatable annotations [#20279](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20279)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix two typos in integration.adoc and webflux.adoc [#29469](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29469)
- Fix typo: "as describe in" -> "as described in" [#29393](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29393)
- Fix typos [#29364](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29364)
- Correct documentation for "other return values" from a web controller method [#29349](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29349)
- Document how to use WebJars without `webjars-locator-core` dependency [#29322](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29322)
- Update RestTemplate Javadoc with regards to setting interceptors on startup vs at runtime [#29311](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29311)
- Document how to switch to the default set of TestExecutionListeners [#29281](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29281)
- Document limitation of AopTestUtils.getUltimateTargetObject() regarding non-static TargetSource [#29276](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29276)
- Fix typo in WebSocket reference doc regarding subscription header [#29228](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29228)
- Fix MockMvc sample setup [#29201](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29201)

:star: New Features

- Support `@RequestPart` arguments for `@HttpExchange` methods [#29420](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29420)
- Processing of charset in Content-Type Header not case-insensitive [#29416](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29416)
- Allow for external customization and i8n of the "title" of an RFC 7807 response [#29407](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29407)
- Automatically register directories for registered resource hints [#29403](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29403)
- Allow registration of resource hint for root directory [#29402](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29402)
- Load `ApplicationContextFailureProcessor` implementations from `spring.factories` [#29387](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29387)
- Simplify mapping of custom exception to an RFC 7807 response in ResponseEntityExceptionHandler [#29384](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29384)
- Introduce SimpleValueStyler for use with ToStringCreator [#29381](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29381)
- Make DefaultValueStyler extensible [#29380](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29380)
- Introduce DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer for MariaDB [#29379](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29379)
- Handle case where `ResponseEntity` and `ProblemDetail` don't agree on the HTTP status to use [#29378](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29378)
- Provide AOT support for `HttpServiceProxyFactory` clients [#29271](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29271)
- Revise logging in the TestContext framework [#29229](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29229)

- Matching path pattern is not set in reactive ServerRequestObservationContext [#29422](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29422)
- PartEvent upload fails with JdkClientHttpConnector [#29400](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29400)
- Native image FileSystem should not be closed after classpath scanning [#29397](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29397)
- AOT processing loses bean aliases [#29391](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29391)
- WebClient and WebFlux Observation do not propagate context [#29388](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29388)
- HttpServiceProxyFactory raises IllegalStateException if created through the builder and declared as a bean [#29376](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29376)
- Multiple `@ImportRuntimeHints` in the type hierarchy should be supported [#29361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29361)

:star: New Features

- Ensure classpath checks can be evaluated at build-time [#29352](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29352)
- Register reflection hints for JPA persistence callbacks [#29348](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29348)
- Check `@RegisterReflectionForBinding` specifies at least one class [#29346](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29346)
- Introduce builder API for AOT processor Settings [#29341](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29341)
- Allow in-progress AOT processing to be detected [#29340](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29340)
- Reorganize HTTP Observation types [#29334](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29334)
- Perform basic property determination without java.beans.Introspector [#29320](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29320)
- Add Kotlin data class components support to `BindingReflectionHintsRegistrar` [#29316](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29316)
- Switch HttpServiceFactory and RSocketServiceProxyFactory to builder model for programmatic configuration first [#29296](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29296)
- Introduce `PreComputeFieldFeature` based on GraalVM `FieldValueTransformer` API [#29081](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29081)
- Introduce SPI for processing ApplicationContext failures in the TestContext framework [#28826](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28826)
- SimpleEvaluationContext should disable array allocation [#28808](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28808)
- DateTimeFormatterRegistrar should fall back to ISO parsing by default [#26985](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26985)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Avoid NPEs in DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention [#29359](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29359)
- ServerHttpObservationFilter can throw ClassCastException when NoopObservation used [#29356](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29356)
- ServerHttpObservationFilter should not overwrite response status [#29353](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29353)
- Possible regression in PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver [#29333](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29333)
- Jackson `Decoder` ignores method parameter information when resolving media types for custom `ObjectMapper` registration [#29307](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29307)
- Deprecation warning for composed Bean Validation constraint annotation [#29206](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29206)
- Code generation no longer supports a list of inner BeanDefinitions [#29075](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29075)
- NamedParameterUtils has broken square brackets handling [#27925](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27925)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Refine `@RegisterReflectionForBinding` Javadoc [#29345](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29345)
- Mention `@ImportRuntimeHints` in `RuntimeHintsRegistrar` Javadoc [#29337](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29337)
- Add Javadoc since for SimpleInstantiationStrategy.setCurrentlyInvokedFactoryMethod() [#29326](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29326)
- Use correct RFC number for ProblemDetail support in Javadoc [#29302](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29302)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Derby 10.16 [#29344](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29344)
- Upgrade to GraalVM 22.3.0 [#29080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29080)
- Upgrade to Jackson 2.14.0-rc2 [#29343](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29343)

:star: New Features

- Add native support for ExceptionHandler and ProblemDetail [#29297](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29297)
- Refine SQLErrorCodesFactory reachability on native images [#29294](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29294)
- Refine `BindingReflectionHintsRegistrar` infrastructure [#29279](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29279)
- Normalize URIs returned from FileSystemResource.getURI() [#29275](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29275)
- Redesign AOT Processors [#29266](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29266)
- Simplify TestRuntimeHintsRegistrar API [#29264](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29264)
- UrlResource#getFilename() should return unencoded file name [#29261](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29261)
- Add reflection hints for EmbeddedDatabaseFactory$EmbeddedDataSourceProxy#shutdown [#29259](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29259)
- Change keyvalue name to http.url in server observations [#29254](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29254)
- Code generator should not use reflection for protected artifacts [#29253](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29253)
- Use MethodArgumentNotValidException for model attribute arguments [#29251](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29251)
- Allow TestCompiler SourceFile to work with records [#29236](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29236)
- Generate matching inner class for inner class configuration [#29213](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29213)
- Kotlin functional config DSL should prevent beans to be registered twice in AOT-optimized contexts [#29211](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29211)
- Allow BeanRegistration target to be any arbitrary class name [#29207](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29207)
- Add support for `Charset` to value code generator [#29186](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29186)
- Enable HTTP and HTTPS on native in spring-web module [#29185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29185)
- Optimize native footprint by avoiding using `ModuleFinder.ofSystem()` at runtime [#29183](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29183)
- Introduce AotProcessor to invoke the AOT engine on an application [#29181](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29181)
- Move TestCompiler to dedicated package [#29175](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29175)
- Use java.nio and FileSystems to resolve files in PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver [#29163](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29163)
- Replace ApplicationContextAotInitializer with an AotApplicationContextInitializer interface [#29157](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29157)
- Enable default TestExecutionListeners in JUnit 4 and TestNG base test classes [#29149](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29149)
- Support cglib generated classes with TestCompiler [#29141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29141)
- Infer AOT proxies created by ProxyFactoryBean [#29097](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29097)
- HTTP interface client ignores `@DateTimeFormat` on path variable [#29095](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29095)
- Integrate the Micrometer Context Propagation library [#29056](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29056)
- Upgrade RestTemplate to HttpClient 5 [#28925](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28925)
- Improve resource handling for empty files contained in jars [#28850](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28850)
- Allow for external customization and i8n of the "detail" of an RFC 7807 response [#28814](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28814)
- Revise `CookieLocaleResolver` to use `ResponseCookie` [#28779](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28779)
- Optimize SpEL and property placeholder support for `@Async` qualifiers [#28549](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28549)
- Customization for ObjectReader and ObjectWriter [#28401](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28401)
- Improve exception message if MultipartParser can not find end of body [#28067](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28067)
- Revisit AOT constructor and factory method resolution [#27920](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27920)
- Support CBOR and Protobuf with Kotlin Serialization [#27628](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27628)
- CGLIB does not allow packages to start with "java" [#27622](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27622)
- Support comma-delimited list of origin patterns in `@CrossOrigin` [#27606](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27606)
- Improve the fluency of the ResponseCreator API [#27280](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27280)
- Support for problem details based on RFC 7807  [#27052](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27052)
- Add fast-path for no-args constructor in BeanUtils.instantiateClass [#24104](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24104)
- Resolve generic type in more complex scenarios [#23418](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23418)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Hints for CGLIB proxies are not consistently registered [#29295](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29295)
- Ensure context caching works properly during AOT runtime in the TestContext framework [#29289](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29289)
- `AbstractJackson2Encoder` encodes empty Flux to invalid JSON [#29274](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29274)
- RuntimeHints accessors have inconsistent naming [#29269](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29269)
- ClassPathResources with same absolute path and same ClassLoader should be equal [#29263](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29263)
- HTTP URL KeyValue should provide entire request URL as a value [#29257](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29257)
- Hints for cglib configuration classes are not registered with a valid name [#29252](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29252)
- Add `ConstantReadableJavaField` caching in `ConstantFieldSubstitutionProcessor` [#29250](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29250)
- StringUtils should parse locale strings without country but with variant [#29248](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29248)
- Generated code does not take visibility of method if it is defined in a parent class [#29245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29245)
- RestTemplate Observation is started without a complete tracing context [#29234](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29234)
- Fix Outcome KeyValues in HTTP observations [#29232](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29232)
- HTTP ObservationConvention implementations miss contextualName [#29231](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29231)
- Refine `ConstantFieldSubstitutionProcessor` error handling [#29219](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29219)
- Align RuntimeHintsAgent behavior with GraalVM reflection changes [#29205](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29205)
- Class meta-annotated with `@Reflective` and annotated with `@RegisterReflectionForBinding` is only processed by SimpleReflectiveProcessor [#29193](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29193)
- Spring Web 6.0.0-M6 breaks Kotlin support for (De-)Serialization in some edge-cases [#29192](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29192)
- BeanDefinitionMethodGenerator should not generate code in the javax package name [#29123](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29123)
- CGLIB proxies are not used at runtime on `@Configuration` classes in AOT mode [#29107](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29107)
- Remove call to requestCompleted in RequestMappingHandlerAdapter [#29002](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29002)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document `PartEvent` API  [#29170](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29170)
- Switch to spring-asciidoctor-backends [#29162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29162)
- Improve Javadoc of BeanRegistrationAotProcessor to describe the "runtime replacement use case" [#29126](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29126)
- Improve Javadoc of GeneratedMethods#add to describe naming conventions [#28997](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28997)

- Upgrade to ASM 9.4 [#29305](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29305)
- Upgrade to Context Propagation 1.0.0-RC1 [#29273](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29273)
- Upgrade to JUnit 5.9.1 [#29179](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29179)
- Upgrade to Kotlin 1.7.20 [#29225](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29225)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.10.0-RC1 [#29241](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29241)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2022.0.0-RC1 [#29268](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29268)

- Refactor HttpServiceProxyFactory to be suitable as an infrastructure bean [#28505](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28505)
- Allow custom HTTP method with `@HttpExchange` methods [#28504](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28504)
- Create UrlResource factory methods that throw unchecked exceptions [#28501](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28501)
- Introduce utility to register hints for an annotation that uses AliasFor [#28497](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28497)
- Support property placeholders in url attribute of `@HttpExchange` [#28492](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28492)
- Support default methods in `@HttpExchange` interface [#28491](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28491)
- Introduce AotDetector mode [#28474](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28474)
- Introduce a meta-annotation that indicates the annotated element requires reflection hints [#28469](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28469)
- Add level guards for trace logging in `SpringFactoriesLoaderRuntimeHintsRegistrar` [#28465](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28465)
- Add resolver for request attributes for `@HttpExchange` methods [#28458](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28458)
- Add WebFlux equivalent of ResponseEntityExceptionHandler [#28439](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28439)
- Avoid collectList when sending a Flux of objects as JSON using WebClient [#28398](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28398)
- Avoid loading XML files for default SQL exception translation [#28216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28216)
- Refine runtime hint conditions [#28126](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28126)
- Provide testing infrastructure for RuntimeHints [#27981](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27981)
-  Simplify default locale/timezone resolution in cookie/session locale resolvers [#27609](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27609)
- Nested Exception's message should not include the messages from causal chain [#25162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25162)
- Add If-Match support and improve If-None-Match wildcard support [#24881](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24881)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Guard against NPE in PathMatchConfigurer [#28816](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28816)
- AnnotationTypeMapping tracks `@AliasFor` mappings as convention-based [#28773](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28773)
- Support by-type constructor references in `ConstructorOrFactoryMethodResolver` [#28728](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28728)
- AOT generated code leads to exception on startup: Object of class [java.lang.Boolean] must be an instance of boolean [#28727](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28727)
- HtmlUnit / MockMvc integration handles forwarded URLs partially [#28722](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28722)
- StackOverflowError when using BindingReflectionHintsRegistrar [#28683](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28683)
- Wrong reflection hints for arrays of inner types [#28664](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28664)
- Add automatic hint for autowired field support [#28655](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28655)
- Reflection configuration for parameter types with an inner class have wrong name [#28606](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28606)
- Fix `ResourceHintsWriter` for leading/trailing wildcards [#28597](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28597)
- JdkHttpClientResourceFactory has dependency  on org.eclipse.jetty [#28588](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28588)
- CompileWithTargetClassAccessClassLoader does not implement findResource [#28574](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28574)
- ScopedProxyBeanRegistrationAotProcessor is never called [#28561](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28561)
- Proxy hint missing when `AliasFor` is used on the annotation itself [#28528](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28528)
- Fix attribute return types in `@DeleteExchange`, `@PatchExchange`, and `@PutExchange` [#28498](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28498)
- Correctly detect Optional return type for `@HttpExchange` methods [#28493](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28493)
- Resolve package cycle around MissingServletRequestPartException [#28455](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28455)
- findAnnotationOnBean finds annotations from a static `@Bean` method's enclosing class [#28298](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28298)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix WebClientAdapter.createHttpServiceProxyFactory() example in ref docs [#28753](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28753)

- Improve `ResourcePatternHint` documentation [#28598](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28598)
- Use getHost instead of getContainerIpAddress in Redis examples [#28461](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28461)
- Update documentation for RFC 7807 support [#28438](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28438)

- MediaType parameters in the "consumes" condition of `@RequestMapping` are not considered for matching [#28024](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28024)

:star: New Features

- Add types to represent RFC 7807 problem details and exceptions [#28187](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28187)
- Update AOT processing to account for multiple init or destroy methods [#28151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28151)
- Introduce ApplicationContextAotGenerator [#28150](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28150)
- Add GeneratedType infrastructure [#28149](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28149)
- Add support for contributing runtime hints for generated code [#28148](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28148)
- Replace KotlinBodySpec with proper ResponseSpec extensions [#28144](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28144)
- Add GraalVM native JSON configuration generation [#28131](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28131)
- Support for compiling and running generated code in tests [#28120](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28120)
- Support for ImportAware in AOT-processed contexts [#28111](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28111)
- Support type-safe transaction rollback rules [#28098](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28098)
- Rationalise merged BeanDefinition resolution for inner beans [#28093](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28093)
- Add API to contribute to the setup of an ApplicationContext [#28088](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28088)
- Deprecate "enclosing classes" search strategy for MergedAnnotations [#28079](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28079)
- Add support for refreshing an ApplicationContext for AOT processing [#28065](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28065)
- Upgrade client support to R2DBC 0.9 [#28059](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28059)
- Improve SpringFactories to customize how arguments and instantiation failures are handled [#28057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28057)
- Remove deprecated SocketUtils [#28054](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28054)
- Add Bean instantiation generator infrastructure [#28047](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28047)
- Add code contribution infrastructure [#28030](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28030)
- Add core JavaPoet utilities [#28028](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28028)
- Add support for registering multiple init & destroy method names [#28013](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28013)
- HibernateJpaDialect compatibility with Hibernate 6 (read-only transactions etc) [#28007](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28007)
- `MissingServletRequestPartException` extends `ServletRequestBindingException` [#27948](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27948)
- Implement an AOT equivalent of AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor [#27921](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27921)
- Add a way to register the need for runtime reflection, resources, proxying, and serialization on components [#27829](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27829)
- Provide repackaged version of JavaPoet [#27828](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27828)
- Allow `@Async` qualifier to be declared with a placeholder or SpEL expression [#27818](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27818)
- Prevent `@Bean` method overloading by default (avoiding accidental overloading and condition mismatches) [#22609](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22609)

- WebSocketConfigurationSupport.DefaultSockJsSchedulerContainer is private and exposed as a Bean [#28146](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28146)
- Inconsistent overriding (and enforcement of non-overriding) between bean definition names and aliases [#27866](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27866)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Avoid unescape when CONNECT and CONNECTED frames [#27722](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27722)

- Change StringUtils trimWhitespace to String.strip() [#27703](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27703)
- Retrieve MethodMetadata for all user-declared methods in the order of declaration [#27701](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27701)
- Refactor HttpMethod from enum to class [#27697](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27697)
- Use parseInt without substring method [#27680](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27680)
- Consistently replace String encoding names with StandardCharset arguments [#27664](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27664)
- Use 'toString(Charset)' instead of 'toString(String)' for encodings [#27646](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27646)
- Add method to ClientResponse that returns Mono terminating with createException [#27637](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27637)
- Create immutable MultiValueMap wrapper [#27608](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27608)
- Revisit MediaType ordering [#27580](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27580)
- Optimize header removal in ForwardedHeaderFilter [#27466](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27466)
- Change default driver in XStreamMarshaller from XppDriver to DomDriver [#27464](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27464)

- change string http header to enum [#27356](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27356)
- Allow BeanUtils#instantiateClass inlining with native [#27072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27072)

- CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor jakarta.annotation-api:2.0.0 support (`@PostConstruct`/Predestroy) [#26185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26185)
- `@Transactional` does not work on package protected methods of CGLib proxies [#25582](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25582)
- Add support for explicit generic type in PayloadApplicationEvent [#24599](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24599)

- Upgrade Spring Context Support to Jakarta EE's com.sun.mail:jakarta.mail and com.sun.activation:jakarta.activation [SPR-17561] [#22093](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22093)
- Enable support for custom vnd types in messaging MappingJackson2MessageConverter [SPR-15712] [#20269](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20269)
- Add support for instant in `@DateTimeFormat` [#19846](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/19846)

:star: New Features

- Add default methods to CachingConfigurer [#27811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27811)

- Convert single `null` argument to `Optional.empty()` in SpEL varargs expression [#27795](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27795)
- Declare serialVersionUID on DefaultAopProxyFactory [#27784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27784)
- The ReactorClientHttpConnector must apply mapper before tcpConfiguration() [#27749](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27749)
- Add getter for RequestMappingInfo builder config [#27723](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27723)
- Give warning when using capturing patterns with the AntPathMatcher [#27688](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27688)
- Support for customization of 404 response when RouterFunctionWebHandler finds no routes [#25358](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25358)
- ModelAndView.status does not work with RedirectView [#25092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25092)
- ThreadPoolExecutorFactoryBean add ability to prestart threads [#1246](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1246)
- Support empty attributes in TagWriter [#910](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/910)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- AsyncConfigurer implementations are loaded too early [#27808](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27808)
- Possible NPE in Spring MVC LogFormatUtils [#27782](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27782)
- Extending CachingConfigurerSupport results in at least one log message about not being eligible for full post-processing [#27751](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27751)
- WebFlux ServerResponse does not overwrite already present response headers [#27741](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27741)
- Passing single null value in varargs SpEL expression results in NullPointerException [#27719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27719)
- UriUtils::extractFileExtension does not properly handle empty file names [#27639](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27639)
- References of CountingBeforeAdvice target its previous location [#22246](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22246)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Remove references to AsyncConfigurerSupport as AsyncConfigurer should be used instead [#27812](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27812)
- Fix javadoc reference to ThrowsAdvice [#27804](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27804)
- Suggested WebSocket config causes circular bean reference [#27746](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27746)
- Document the difference in generics resolution between `@Autowired` and `beanFactory.getBeanProvider` [#27727](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27727)

- Fix incorrect example of error handling in WebClient Javadoc [#27645](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27645)

- Clarify behaviour of AnnotationBeanNameGenerator with acronyms [#2030](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/2030)
- Fix simple data format in appendix [#1025](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1025)
- Update StoredProcedure.java declareParameter method JavaDoc [#1000](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1000)
- Document `@Bean` definitions via default methods [#767](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/767)
- Improved DataBinder Javadoc for xxx*yyy pattern matching. [#699](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/699)

- Configure CommonsMultipartResolver to support specific HTTP methods [#27161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27161)
- Allow BeanDefinitionBuilder to set an instance supplier with a ResolvableType [#27160](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27160)
- Reason of `@ResponseStatus` on handler method is not resolved by MessageSource [#27156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27156)
- ResourceHandlerRegistry#getHandlerMapping should initialize handler once in outer loop [#27153](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27153)
- Set synthetic flag using BeanDefinitionBuilder [#27141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27141)
- BeanCreationException error message should always include declaring class of constructor (or factory method) [#27139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27139)
- Improve Jetty 10 check in JettyClientHttpResponse [#27136](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27136)
- Jetty10RequestUpgradeStrategy use an old jetty 9 class HandshakeRFC6455 [#27121](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27121)
- ClassNotFoundException using Jetty 10 and its reactive client [#27112](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27112)
- Use StringBuilder.append(char) where possible [#27098](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27098)
- Consider "wss" and "https" for secure flag in Forwarded header checks [#27097](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27097)
- SynchronossPartHttpMessageReader should only create temp directory when needed [#27092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27092)
- Implement equals, hashCode, & toString in BeanMethod and *Metadata types [#27076](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27076)
- Remove logging dependency in BeanUtils [#27070](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27070)
- Exclude sealed interfaces from auto-proxying (for JDK 17 compatibility) [#27027](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27027)
- Blockhound error when running with transaction with a TransactionOperator [#26955](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26955)
- Configure StandardServletMultipartResolver to only support multipart/form-data [#26826](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26826)
- Add a way to set executeExistingDelayedTasksAfterShutdown from ThreadPoolTaskScheduler [#26719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26719)
- Apply dynamic changes in ThreadPoolTaskExecutor before setting local value [#26700](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26700)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- JettyHttpHandlerAdapter is not aware of Server[Request|Response]Wrapper [#27146](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27146)
- {*path} pattern (CaptureTheRestPathElement) includes undocumented leading slash in `@PathVariable` path [#27132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27132)
- NoSuchMethodError when invoke JettyWebSocketSession.getRemoteAddress in jetty 10 [#27120](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27120)
- CronExpression is *still* broken on spring-context-5.3.8 [#27117](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27117)
- SimpleMethodMetadataReadingVisitor.Source.toString() omits separator for method arguments [#27095](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27095)
- DefaultPathSegment allows shared empty parameters map to be mutated [#27064](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27064)
- AOP auto-proxying with proxyTargetClass=true and introduction advice does not work for JDK proxy targets [#27044](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27044)
- ServletRequestDataBinder assumes Standard servlet multipart handling [#26999](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26999)
- DataClassRowMapper should not override Kotlin init properties [#26569](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26569)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add Javadoc `@since` to `BeanDefinitionBuilder.setSynthetic()` [#27155](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27155)
- Fix link to Javadoc API [#27151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27151)
- Added description for HandlerInterceptor [#27122](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27122)
- Fix typo in core-beans.adoc [#27113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27113)
- Fix typo in BeanDefinitionDsl.kt [#27105](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27105)
- Improve docs for getContentAsByteArray method of ContentCachingRequestWrapper [#27068](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27068)
- Fix explanation on default settings for content negotiation in reference doc [#27067](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27067)
- Document that any `@Valid*` annotation triggers validation in the reference manual [#27050](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27050)
- Improve RequestPartMethodArgumentResolver Javadoc [#27043](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27043)
- Improve RequestResponseBodyMethodProcessor Javadoc [#27042](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27042)
- Clarify that baseName in ResourceBundleMessageSource does not support multiple locations [#27038](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27038)
- Link alternate documentation formats [#27015](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27015)

- spring-context-indexer doesn't support Java records [#26909](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26909)
- Ignore trailing slash in CorsConfiguration origin patterns [#26892](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26892)
- RSocketRequester disposal of underlying RSocketClient [#26886](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26886)
- Add PreFlightRequestWebFilter [#26885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26885)
- Avoid memory leak when PropertyComparator is reused [#26869](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26869)
- Support MySQL safe updates mode in MySQLMaxValueIncrementer [#26858](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26858)
- HttpStatus.resolve allocates HttpStatus.values() once per invocation [#26842](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26842)
- InvalidPathException in log when running SpringBootTest with NIO Path property on Windows [#26828](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26828)
- Use String.startsWith() instead of String.substring() in PatternMatchUtils [#26822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26822)
- Access to the cachedSessions in CachingConnectionFactory [#26811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26811)
- Reduce log level in ExecutorConfigurationSupport.initialize [#26810](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26810)
- Avoid exceptions when evaluating validation hints [#26787](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26787)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- UriComponentsBuilder handles invalid port numbers correctly [#26905](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26905)
- Incorrect check in AbstractBrokerRegistration's constructor [#26896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26896)
- DataClassRowMapper doesn't correctly convert generic fields [#26881](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26881)
- `CorsRegistration#combine` is a noop [#26877](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26877)
- LinkedCaseInsensitiveMap#putIfAbsent does not honor the case where the key is associated with a null value [#26868](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26868)
- Provide control over fallback charset to use in WebClientResponseException [#26866](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26866)
- `@ModelAttribute(binding=false)` is not honored with WebFlux [#26856](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26856)
- Fix Kotlin filter parameter bug in Router DSLs [#26838](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26838)
- AbstractListenerReadPublisher publishing onComplete signal before onNext during heavy load [#26834](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26834)
- MockMvc's MVC_RESULT_ATTRIBUTE lost with HandlerMappingIntrospector and RouterFunctions in use [#26833](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26833)

- Daylight saving time issue in CronExpression [#26830](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26830)
- HandlerMappingIntrospector does not work with PathPattern backed HandlerMappings [#26814](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26814)
- Addition of fallback patterns to DateFormatter loses cause in Spring 5.3.5 [#26804](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26804)
- Support empty file uploads with HtmlUnit and MockMvc [#26799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26799)
- Cache setup failure does not provide nested cause [#25250](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25250)
- Fix web parameters resolution when injected via constructor [#25200](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25200)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document feature to load `@ModelAttribute`  through type conversion from a request value [#26873](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26873)
- Improve advice on response handling in an ExchangeFilterFunction [#26819](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26819)
- Remove leftover Javadoc from WebClient [#26807](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26807)
- Add information about changed behaviour for resolving `@AuthenticationPrincipal` annotation [#26791](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26791)

- Subscriber context not propagated to WebSocketHandler for Tomcat websockets [#26210](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26210)
- Introduce ApplicationEvents abstraction to capture application events published during a test [#25616](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25616)
- Spring AOP should not apply UndeclaredThrowableException to checked exceptions from Kotlin methods [#23844](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23844)

- Avoid CGLIB proxies in websocket/messaging configuration [#26227](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26227)
- ContentCachingResponseWrapper should not add “Content-Length” when “Transfer-Encoding” is present [#26182](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26182)
- Allow customization of file extension to media type map for WebFlux static resources [#26170](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26170)
- Register bean definition dependencies when used via configuration class injected fields [#26167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26167)
- Print helpful information in RSocket MetadataExtractor [#26130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26130)
- Add ResponseSpec#toEntityFlux overload that accepts BodyExtractor [#26114](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26114)
- Wildcard is a valid Access-Control-Expose-Headers value [#26113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26113)
- Reduce overhead of char[] creation [#26101](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26101)
- EntityManagerFactory startup failure in deferred mode is only available on first use [#26093](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26093)
- `@DynamicPropertySource` is not supported via `@NestedTestConfiguration` semantics [#26091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26091)
- Introduce and() methods in MethodFilter and FieldFilter for composite filters [#26063](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26063)
- Kotlin extensions for WebClient.ResponseSpec [#26030](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26030)
- Validate that JUnit Jupiter test methods and lifecycle methods are not annotated with `@Autowired` [#25966](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25966)
- Add support for SSE to WebMvc.fn [#25920](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25920)
- Template URI Variables with newline %0A or %0D are not matched  [#23252](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23252)

- DataBufferUtils#join may release a DataBuffer more than necessary [#26060](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26060)

- Non-compliant Content-Type header for multipart media types [#25885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25885)

- MergedAnnotationCollectors.toAnnotationSet() should not create intermediate ArrayList [#26031](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26031)

- DefaultWebClientBuilder copies references [#25992](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25992)
- Inefficient request handling inside ServletRequestDataBinder [#25986](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25986)
- Avoid multiple volatile reads/writes in a row where only one is enough [#25899](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25899)
- Allows Jackson2 encoders to log Throwable reason for not being able to serialize or deserialize [#25892](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25892)
- Mechanism to access request bound objects in WebClient filter in servlet env [#25710](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25710)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- SseEmitter: connection closed after first event [#25987](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25987)
- `@Nonnull` annotation breaks ServletRequestMethodArgumentResolver for Principal [#25981](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25981)

- Expose access to STOMP SimpleMessageBroker sessions user Principal [#25191](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25191)
- Allow programmatic registration of completion and error callbacks to transactional event listeners [#24163](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24163)
- Support suspending functions annotated with `@Transactional` [#23575](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23575)
- StompBrokerRelay doesn't send heartbeats to broker when `@MessageMapping` handles received messages [#22822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22822)

- `@NestedTestConfiguration` should not be discovered on enclosing class for nested interface [#25917](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25917)
- UriComponentsBuilder controller method argument has no path [#25822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25822)
- Support multiple matchers in MockMvc Kotlin DSL [#24103](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24103)

- Add MariaDB to the supported database products for procedures and functions [#25811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25811)
- Optimize String argument resolution in MessageTag [#25809](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25809)
- Avoid repeated Charset resolution in MimeType [#25808](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25808)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Incorrect http response for a request using the Range header for pre-compressed resources [#25976](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25976)
- `@ActiveProfiles` with same profiles but different order results in duplicate ApplicationContext [#25973](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25973)
- LinkedMultiValueMap downstream issue with MultiValueMapAdapter package private base class [#25960](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25960)
- DataBufferUtils.CompositeMatcher causes poor performance when one or more matchers does not match [#25915](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25915)
- HttpSeverOperations overrides content-length to 0 on HTTP HEAD [#25908](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25908)
- jsessionid breaks request mappings when removeSemicolonContent is turned off [#25864](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25864)
- JettyClientHttpConnector triggers early cancellation [#25849](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25849)
- Race condition in DataBufferUtils.readAsynchronousFileChannel resulting in FD leak (Channel remains open) [#25831](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25831)
- SimpMessagingTemplate.convertAndSend results in UnsupportedOperationException when Spring Cloud Sleuth is present [#25821](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25821)
- ClassCastException when wiring bean using method injection (NullBean instead of 'null') [#25806](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25806)
- Thread-scoped bean creation freezes if dependent bean is retrieved before dependency bean  [#25801](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25801)
- Sending an event as part of the EMF lock triggers a deadlock [#25799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25799)
- Wrong type inference in Kotlin while overriding RequestMappingHandlerMapping#getMappingForMethod [#25657](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25657)
- SseEmitter (ResponseBodyEmitter) keeps collecting messages if not initialized [#25442](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25442)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Correct DispatcherServlet initialization sample webmvc.adoc [#25965](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25965)
- Document that TransactionalEventListener only works with non-reactive transactions [#25805](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25805)
- Published reference documentation contains unnecessary folders and files [#25783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25783)
- Incorrect example in javadocs of Assert.notNull(object, messageSupplier) [#25774](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25774)

- MultipartFile[] required controller param, not throwing exception [#25819](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25819)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Prevent confusion about build(boolean) method in UriComponentsBuilder [#25701](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25701)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Reactor Californium-SR21 [#25731](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25731)

- Introduce getBeanProvider variants with allowEagerInit flag [#25559](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25559)
- Allow to access the underlying ConnectionFactory from DatabaseClient [#25521](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25521)
- Optimize DefaultLifecycleProcessor::startBeans [#25506](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25506)
- Refactoring opportunity in HandlerExecutionChain [#25500](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25500)
- Support macros in crontab expressions [#25471](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25471)
- Introduce CronExpression [#25464](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25464)
- Use System.currentTimeMillis() in AbstractSockJsService [#25447](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25447)
- Simplified return statement [#25415](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25415)
- Improve UriComponents.sanitizeSource() [#25401](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25401)
- Use Math.min() in ExponentialBackOff [#25381](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25381)
- Allow auto grow for entries without default constructor in SpEL [#25367](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25367)
- Remove redundant Character.toLowerCase() in BeanPropertyRowMapper [#25361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25361)
- Leverage spring.ignore.xml flag to avoid XmlBeanDefinitionReader [#25338](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25338)
- Leverage spring.ignore.xml flag to avoid SQLErrorCodeSQLExceptionTranslator [#25335](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25335)
- Check for valid IPv6 host in UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString [#25334](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25334)
- Support use of RSocketClient [#25332](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25332)
- Enhance HandlerMappingIntrospector to cache parsed patterns [#25312](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25312)
- DefaultSubscriptionRegistry: Reduced thread contention [#25298](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25298)
- Support multiple Content-Language header values in MockHttpServletResponse [#25281](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25281)
- added possibility to extend ModelAttributeMethodArgumentResolver  [#25265](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25265)
- WebSocketMessage's methods `fromMessage` and `toFrames` ignore  Netty WebSocketFrame metadata  [#25099](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25099)
- Support for pattern based origin cors configuration [#25016](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25016)
- Collect metrics during application context startup [#24878](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24878)
- Sort detected PersistenceExceptionTranslator beans [#24644](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24644)
- Constructor based bean binding should support url path variables, not only request parameters [#24107](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24107)
- Feature request: provide support for JSR 310 types in CronTrigger [#23496](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23496)
- RouterFunction does not respect path matching set in WebFluxConfigurer [#23236](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23236)
- Turn MethodArgumentNotValidException into subclass of BindException [#23107](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23107)
- Support for direct path lookups in WebFlux [#22961](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22961)
- ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver should support exceptions from any handler [#22619](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22619)
- `@Scheduled`(cron = "0 0 0 ? * 5#3") is not supported [#22436](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22436)
- Consider updating the default Hibernate dialect for MySQL databases [#22326](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22326)
- Spring MVC - Kotlin: Cannot bind MultipartFile in constructor [SPR-17640] [#22169](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22169)
- Support JSON streaming formats besides application/stream+json [#21283](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21283)
- Support raising exception with a custom HTTP status code [#20336](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20336)
- Support for the last day in month cron expression [SPR-15547] [#20106](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20106)
- Cron Expression validation [SPR-14933] [#19500](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/19500)
- Cron expression with fixed weekday and fixed date may or may not lead to IllegalStateException (runaway search for next trigger) [SPR-8981] [#13621](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13621)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- MockHttpServletResponse's setCharacterEncoding() does not update contentType property [#25536](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25536)
- Bean overriding for 'taskExecutor' alias is not detected [#25430](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25430)
- Creating ServerRequest from MockHttpServletRequest changed behaviour 5.3.0-M1 [#25353](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25353)
- CaffeineCache does not support LoadingCache consistently [#25173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25173)
- CronSequenceGenerator - Friday 13th issue [SPR-17036] [#21574](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21574)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Use Groovy syntax highlighting in reference manual [#25554](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25554)
- Fix comment syntax in xml examples [#25537](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25537)
- Fix links in Javadoc [#25448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25448)
- Fix typo in javadoc [#25396](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25396)
- Add logging reference documentation [SPR-17626] [#22158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22158)

- Upgrade to Jackson 2.11.2 [#25398](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25398)

- Upgrade to ASM 9.0 [#24872](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24872)
- Upgrade to Kotlin 1.4 RC [#24171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24171)

- MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter might be too specific in its Charset support [#25322](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25322)
