- Implement reliable invocation order for advice within an `@Aspect` [#25186](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25186)
- Performance enhancement in execution of ResponseEntity.of() [#25183](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25183)
- Support for shared GroovyClassLoader in GroovyScriptFactory [#25177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25177)
- Suggest making a Set.size() > 0 judgement for AbstractApplicationContext.earlyApplicationEvents [#25161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25161)
- Make use of custom types configurable in YamlProcessor [#25152](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25152)
- Avoid need for default constructor in ContextAnnotationAutowireCandidateResolver subclasses [#25131](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25131)
-  ConstructorResolver.resolveConstructorArguments() return value issue [#25130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25130)
- Introduce serializeToByteArray/deserializeFromByteArray convenience methods [#25117](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25117)
- Custom HTTP Method on MockServerHttpRequest [#25109](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25109)
- Missing null checks in AbstractMessageChannel.addInterceptor/setInterceptors [#25088](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25088)
- Avoid full synchronization in AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext.getBeanFactory() since it can lead to massive thread blocking [#25081](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25081)
- Simplify use of HttpContext in HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory in support of user associated connections [#25066](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25066)
- ResolvableType forClass fails when a type in the generic signature isn't present [#25064](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25064)
- Include timeout unit in shutdown failure logging [#25058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25058)
- Drop unnecessary intermediate StringBuilder.toString() call in ServerSentEventHttpMessageReader [#25024](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25024)
- Fix concurrency issues in XStreamMarshaller [#25017](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25017)
- Introduce mechanism to discover whether a reactive type registered in ReactiveAdapterRegistry uses deferred computation [#24995](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24995)
- Avoid logging exception for closed session in AbstractSockJsSession [#24986](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24986)
- Include response body in RestTemplate exception when there is no suitable HttpMessageConverter [#24964](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24964)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- ExchangeStrategies custom codec's reader & writer are not registered [#25149](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25149)
- MultiValueMapAdapter.getFirst fails with IndexOutOfBoundsException in case of empty List [#25140](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25140)
- WebSphereUowTransactionManager causes exception for PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS when timeout is specified [#25132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25132)
- Avoid ClassCastException on IllegalArgumentException when invoking sync get cache method [#25110](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25110)
- DefaultServerRequestBuilder does not respect attributes when building the ServerRequest [#25106](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25106)
- Fix race condition in WriteResultPublisher between subscription and error in publishError [#25096](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25096)
- Jackson message converters and codecs do not respect character encoding in canRead/canWrite [#25076](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25076)
- DefaultClientResponseBuilder empty logPrefix when creating a DefaultClientResponse based on another [#25069](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25069)
- HttpHeaders equals may return false without comparing actual content [#25034](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25034)
- Fix race condition in WriteResultPublisher between subscription and completion in publishComplete [#24989](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24989)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Javadoc for hibernate5 OpenSessionInViewFilter mentions FlushMode.NEVER [#25158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25158)
- Document that the Map backing a MapPropertySource should not contain null values [#25142](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25142)
- Javadoc for JdbcOperations.batchUpdate should mention that negative values are possible [#25138](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25138)
- Fix URI pattern example in webflux.adoc [#25137](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25137)
- Document how reactive transactions work for cancellation in 5.2 and how it will work in 5.3 [#25091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25091)
- Document whether code can rely on specific subclasses of HttpClientErrorException/HttpServerErrorException being thrown from DefaultResponseErrorHandler [#25067](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25067)
- Fix SpelEvaluationException with example code [#25045](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25045)
- javadoc: remove a comment documented a limitation on `@Lookup` annotation [#25044](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25044)
- Document all predefined variables from ApplicationContext available in SpEL expressions [#25037](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25037)
- Document ReactiveTransactionManager support in reference manual [#25036](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25036)
- Document ReactiveTransactionManager support [#25030](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25030)
- Change to placeholder value in XML is not reevaluated at runtime [#25022](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25022)
- Add missing `@PathVariable` declarations in examples in webmvc.adoc [#25006](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25006)

- Illegal reflective access warning for interface-based lookup method injection [#24657](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24657)
- Annotation retrieval performance degradation after 5.2 [#23905](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23905)

- Avoid ClassCastException for CoyoteInputStream in TomcatHttpHandlerAdapter [#24707](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24707)
- Avoid unnecessary sorting in AbstractHandlerMethodMapping [#24704](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24704)

- Relax GraalVM checks in DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer [#24600](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24600)
- Multipart/related support in Spring Webclient [#24582](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24582)
- Consider supporting PreFlight requests and CORS in Servlet Functional Endpoints [#24564](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24564)
- Support for byte-range requests in Servlet Functional endpoints [#24562](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24562)
- Provide a mechanism to configure integration tests with a dynamic property source [#24540](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24540)
- Improve ConcurrentLruCache performance [#24469](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24469)

- implements `checkNotModified` for `ServerRequest` [#24173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24173)

- addCandidateComponentsFromIndex should create ScannedGenericBeanDefinitions [#24638](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24638)

- Polish ReactorResourceFactory [#24620](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24620)

- MockRestServiceServer reset does not clear failedRequests [#24486](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24486)
- Prevent unnecessary refresh for InjectionMetadata.EMPTY [#24485](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24485)
- "Status and headers already sent" ISE exception from Reactor Netty on WebSocket upgrade [#24475](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24475)

- Cycle in LogAdapter.Log4jLog initialization within log appender [#24440](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24440)
- Negative byte values not properly converted to unsigned int in URI encoding [#24413](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24413)
- ServerSentEventHttpMessageReader maps null when event has comment only. [#24389](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24389)
- Nested annotations no longer supported in ASM-based annotation processing [#24375](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24375)
- Explicit Content-Type Header in WebClient is overwritten by ResourceHttpMessageWriter [#24366](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24366)
- Avoid setting special Content-* response headers in TomcatHeadersAdapter [#24361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24361)
- IncompatibleClassChangeError encountered on execution of compiled SPEL expressions [#24357](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24357)
- JSON decoding error parsing stream encoded with Jackson Smile [#24198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24198)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Improve documentation for `@Autowired`/`@Value` in `@Configuration` classes [#24585](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24585)
- Fix formatting in webflux-webclient.adoc [#24578](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24578)
- Clarify AbstractResourceBasedMessageSource.setCacheMillis vs java.util.ResourceBundle [#24563](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24563)

- Fix javadoc in DependencyDescriptor [#24551](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24551)
- Correct formatting of MessageSource example in documentation [#24531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24531)
- Update advice on RestTemplate [#24503](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24503)
- Upgrade to Spring Asciidoctor Extensions 0.4.0.RELEASE [#24481](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24481)
- Fix typo in StringUtils class [#24471](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24471)
- Polish documentation format [#24460](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24460)

- Update throwable to SQLException [#24337](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24337)
- Update CORS support  [#24327](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24327)
- Improve exception message in AopContext.currentProxy() [#24321](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24321)
- Trim line in LineInfo only once [#24310](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24310)
- Merge getCallableInterceptors and getDeferredResultInterceptors [#24305](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24305)
- Optimize SimpleAliasRegistry hasAlias implementation [#24295](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24295)
- Improve ExposeInvocationInterceptor exception message [#24293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24293)
- Add ContentLength support for InputStreamResource created in ResourceHttpMessageConverter and ResourceDecoder [#24292](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24292)
- StringHttpMessageConverter addDefaultHeaders() should check media type for wildcard before setting it into headers [#24283](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24283)
- Add fast path for ClassUtils.hasMethod [#24282](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24282)
- Support headers with multiple values in ResponseStatusException [#24261](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24261)
- Remove quality parameter from chosen media type in WebFlux responses [#24239](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24239)
- Remove Content-* response headers before error handling in WebFlux [#24238](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24238)
- Reuse InputStream for ResourceRegionHttpMessageConverter [#24214](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24214)
- Un-deprecate PathResource (for java.nio.file.Path resolution in createRelative) [#24211](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24211)
- Simplify AdvisedSupport.removeAdvisor() [#24205](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24205)
- Add BeanPropertyRowMapper.newInstance(mappedClass, conversionService) [#24195](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24195)
- Short-circuit in AbstractBeanDefinition.equals() [#24185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24185)
- Expose local address in reactive ServerHttpRequest [#24174](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24174)
- Improve exception message for mixed explicit and implicit aliases with `@AliasFor` [#24168](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24168)
- Hoist constant result of SerializableTypeWrapper.unwrap() out of loop [#24167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24167)
- Add "application/*+xml" as supported media type to XML decoders [#24164](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24164)
- Hoist Class.getName() from String concatenation to dodge an issue related to profile pollution [#24153](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24153)
- Let UriUtils.encode…(…) methods optimize for sources without the need to be encoded [#24152](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24152)
- Add accessor for logPrefix in ClientResponse to allow tying a ClientRequest to a ClientResponse [#24146](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24146)
- Support variable resolution of wildcard types [#24145](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24145)
- WebTestClientExtensions.expectBody doesn't work for generic types [#24142](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24142)
- Add firstElement to CollectionUtils [#24135](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24135)
- Improve configuration API of ClientCodecConfigurer.CustomCodecs [#24124](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24124)
- Introduce BeanNameGenerator based on fully qualified class name [#24114](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24114)
- ContentDisposition cannot parse encoded filename with leading space [#24112](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24112)
- Add option to encode MultiValueMap of query params  [#24043](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24043)
- AbstractMessageConverterMethodProcessor results in 406 with "Accept: */*" when `@RequestMapping` produces condition determined the content type [#23287](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23287)
- Allow testing with any value for Content-Type and Accept header in MockHttpServletRequestBuilder [#2079](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/2079)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- StringDecoder buffer leak related to maxInMemorySize limit [#24339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24339)
- Cloning a WebClient.Builder instance does not copy strategiesConfigurers [#24329](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24329)
- SimpleKey contains invalid hashcode on deserialization when parameters include an enum [#24320](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24320)
- ServerSentEventHttpMessageReader does not respect maxInMemorySize and is always limited to 256k messages [#24312](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24312)
- Unsafe double-checked locking in SpelExpression#compileExpression [#24265](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24265)
- Ensure CORS processing does not add Vary header twice on async requests [#24223](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24223)
- Escape quotes in filename in ContentDisposition.Builder when charset not specified [#24220](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24220)
- ClassUtils.getInterfaceMethodIfPossible overhead in cached methods for SpEL key/condition expressions [#24206](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24206)
- ClientCodecConfigurer drops MultipartHttpMessageWriter.partWriters when mutated [#24194](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24194)
- Regression: annotation searches no longer handle exceptions [#24188](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24188)
- WebFlux may send incomplete response if the session persistence fails [#24186](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24186)
- Fix RSocketRequester Coroutines extensions [#24166](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24166)
- Regression: prototype `@ControllerAdvice` beans should not be cached [#24157](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24157)
- Ensure MvcUriComponentsBuilder generates correct URL from type-level mapping without leading slash [#24143](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24143)
- Annotation scanning in enclosing class hierarchy results in NoClassDefFound  [#24136](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24136)
- ReadCancellationException does not play well with `onErrorContinue` [#24125](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24125)
- StringHttpMessageConverter lost a fix that assumed charset UTF-8 for "application/json" [#24123](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24123)
- Regression: default values for implicit aliases no longer honored in MergedAnnotations [#24110](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24110)
- Functional Bean Definition DSL for noarg functions [#23395](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23395)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Docs should warn against split URL handling across handler mappings [#24304](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24304)
- [spring expression doc] symbolic logical operators [#24276](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24276)
- Fix example in RSocket docs [#24245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24245)
- MappingJackson2MessageConverter: fix javadoc typo [#24200](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24200)
- Fix typos in DataBufferUtils Javadocs [#24160](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24160)
- TOC generated by asciidoc for core-beans.adoc is truncated [#24132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24132)
